name: @wordpress/core-data
description: ArtisanPack UI visual-editor shim for @wordpress/core-data (issue #808 H4). Redirects every resolution of @wordpress/core-data to the in-repo empty-state shim so Vite's dep pre-bundler and its source pipeline resolve to the same absolute file, producing one module instance instead of a split-brain across the wp-data registry.
